title: Evaluation of the Middle-Layer Fourier Polynomial
statement: Let $m$ be a nonnegative integer, and on the sign cube with $2m$ coordinates let $f$ be the indicator of vectors having exactly $m$ positive coordinates. For each coordinate subset $U$, let $\widehat f(U)$ be the uniform Fourier coefficient of $f$ at $U$. For every real $\rho$, the middle-layer Fourier polynomial evaluated at $\rho$ equals $\sum_{U\subseteq[2m]}\widehat f(U)\rho^{|U|}$.
